change: Measure each status/pause chat turn by elapsed request time, then repeat the existing native live acceptance case in 30 isolated pytest processes with the already configured model chain. Preserve each diagnostic transcript/log and durable sample start/finish, including nonzero exits and partial turns. Refuse an existing cohort directory.
failure_contract: An injected first-conversation failure preserves its partial timeout transcript and nonzero exit while all 29 remaining samples are still recorded. Reusing its output directory refuses before another execution. Subprocess native-journal interruption checks also pass.

live_run.business_resources: Fresh private PostgreSQL goal/task data and synthetic business dispatch; no scheduler or production goal changes.

limits: The live conversations use an isolated minimal agent configuration and selected model chain. State assertions do not substitute for human review of language, and the prior accepted scripted status/pause case remains the only accepted manual result. Full acceptance and broader fallback/representative-workload comparison remain open. No production deployment.
